analysis.rationale: Two-step pipeline: blur (strong, gm_ratio=0.199) then JPEG (block_boundary=8.393, 0%FP). No noise (peeled sigma=1.48<2, residual spatial_corr=0.967 structured → known extreme_pct IMPULSE false positive; impulse:1 control gave no gain). No global: saturation sev2 (-4.3dB), contrast_weaken_scale sev2 (-4.8dB), contrast_weaken_stretch sev2 (-7.1dB) all collapse PSNR/unique counts → variance_ratio=0.732 is a blur+JPEG byproduct. Blur subtype: glass DT branch (glass_score=1.62>0.25) is INVALIDATED here — a pure blur_gaussian:5+compression_jpeg:4 simulation scores glass_score=1.69 in the same analyzer, so glass_score is JPEG-inflated; gaussian family preferred (wiener kernel MATCH >0.85; glass fails at 0.831). All 21 candidates plateau at PSNR 21-28.5dB (best gaussian4+jpeg4=28.21, CI 8/10, block 1%, slope 0.188); no deterministic combo reaches exact-match (>30dB), signature of an unresolved stochastic component (glass cannot be excluded) or off-grid severity. Severity: gm_ratio trend (sim gaussian5 gm=0.138 vs target 0.199; slope sim 1.389 vs target 1.132) indicates blur < sev5, sev3-4 tie at PSNR 28.2 → choose sev4. JPEG sev3 vs 4 tie in PSNR (28.48 vs 28.21) but block_boundary CI 16% vs 1% and signal raw diff 13% → sev4. Single support pair (k=1), no cross-pair validation possible.
